issues.description: The problem statement (UML and textual description) specifies that Milkable.messageOnMilk() returns a boolean (true/false), but the solution implements Milkable.messageOnMilk() with return type String (and Goat/Seal return strings describing milking). This mismatch will confuse students about which signature to implement and which return type the tests expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across specification, template, and solution. Either: (A) Update the problem statement (UML and textual description) to specify that messageOnMilk() returns a String (and give an example like "Goat <name> is milked"), or (B) change the solution and any template examples to have messageOnMilk() return boolean (and adjust Goat/Seal implementations and any code that prints the milking result accordingly). Ensure tests and Main examples match the chosen signature.
